svg.title: Attention qualification · jit-on
svg.text: Only PASS cells receive a main / patched latency ratio; >1 means the patch is faster.
M: main; P: patched. T: sequence length; D: per-head dimension. Same B2 / H4 causal fixture.
Q: qualified; U: unqualified. RUNTIME: execution failed; MIXED: distinct failure types. ABBA: two processes per variant.
These are individual attention operators. They do not measure transformer training or qualify the five-engine study.
